name: DME
notes: reference coordinating solvent; DOL/DME + LiTFSI/LiNO3 is the standard Li-S electrolyte
reference: Mikhaylik & Akridge, J. Electrochem. Soc. 151, A1969 (2004); Liu et al., Joule 5, 2323 (2021)

name: DOL
notes: co-solvent of the standard Li-S electrolyte; polymerizes on Li to form the SEI
reference: Mikhaylik & Akridge, J. Electrochem. Soc. 151, A1969 (2004); Liu et al., Joule 5, 2323 (2021)

name: DMM
notes: weakly solvating ether used in sparingly solvating Li-S electrolytes
reference: review: Commun. Mater. 2025 (sparingly solvating electrolytes for Li-S)

name: THP
notes: weakly solvating cyclic ether used in sparingly solvating Li-S electrolytes
reference: review: Commun. Mater. 2025 (sparingly solvating electrolytes for Li-S)

name: diglyme
notes: strongly coordinating glyme; solvate ionic liquids Li(glyme)TFSI for Li-S
reference: Dokko et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 160, A1304 (2013)

name: triglyme
notes: strongly coordinating glyme; [Li(G3)]TFSI solvate ionic liquid for Li-S
reference: Dokko et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 160, A1304 (2013)

name: F5DEE
notes: weakly solvating fluorinated diethoxyethane; CONFIRM SMILES against the paper's SI

name: FDMB
notes: weakly solvating fluoroether; ~99.5 % CE on Li metal

name: EMP
notes: NON-fluorinated ether reaching ~98.8-99.3 % CE on Li metal; found by solvent embeddings
reference: Kumar, Wang & Amanchukwu, Mol. Syst. Des. Eng. (2026)

name: OFE
notes: diluent in sparingly solvating Li-S electrolytes; CONFIRM SMILES; (CF2)3 chain at the PFAS limit
reference: review: Commun. Mater. 2025 (sparingly solvating electrolytes for Li-S)

name: TFTFE
notes: fluoroether diluent used in Li-S to suppress the shuttle
reference: review: Commun. Mater. 2025; Azimi et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 162, A64 (2015) (verify)

name: BTFE
notes: LHCE diluent; used with LiFSI in Li-SPAN localized high-concentration electrolytes
reference: Ren et al., Chem 4, 1877 (2018); Miao et al., ACS Energy Lett. 8, 1927 (2023) (Li-SPAN review)

name: TFEO
notes: LHCE diluent giving monolithic LiF-rich SEI on Li metal
